posts.html:

posts.author: Crackshotkeg
posts.title: Re: fallout 3, farcry 2 or cod world at war?
posts.html:
If ya like exploring, go for fallout 3 it will take you a long time to do everything, and then you can still piss around aswell.
If ya like that classic FPS game where you can also blow legs off with grenades, then Cod5 is the game for you!
And finally if you like driving, and deciding tactically how you want to go about doing a mission, go for Far cry 2.
